reference: Independent server-side delivered payload, aligned by epoch clocks on this host to the actual client measurement window. Configured rate limits are reported separately from delivered throughput.
limitations: A shared application-level pacer, not an OS packet shaper or physical radio. v4 comparison replays its point estimator over the acquired counters; it does not run v4 transports. Native app and production paths require separate acceptance.
